question: Comparing the life ladder of Asia and Europe to tell me which region is worth to live?
query: SELECT   r.regional_indicator,   AVG(whr.life_ladder) AS avg_life_ladder FROM world_happiiness_report AS whr JOIN (   SELECT     'Asia' AS regional_indicator   UNION ALL   SELECT     'Europe' ) AS r   ON whr.regional_indicator = r.regional_indicator GROUP BY   r.regional_indicator ORDER BY   avg_life_ladder DESC LIMIT 50;
